geo-min-01-c1.text: National Park Service (Geologic Resources Division). Minerals. National Park Service, U.S. Department of the Interior.
geo-min-01-c1.quote: Have a definite chemical composition (may vary within given limits) that is the same everywhere the mineral occurs
geo-min-01-c1.claim: a mineral must be naturally occurring, inorganic, solid, have a definite chemical composition, and have an ordered crystalline structure

geo-min-01-c2.text: Georgia State University, HyperPhysics. Olivine. HyperPhysics, Georgia State University.
geo-min-01-c2.quote: Though not abundant in continental rocks, olivine is yet thought to be a major component of the upper mantle of the Earth.
geo-min-01-c2.claim: Olivine (Mg,Fe)₂SiO₄ is a major component of the upper mantle.
